notes.title: Index Controller Update
notes.notes:
upgraded SteamVR version to better support index controllers
 weapons can now be picked up by either hand
 shield is changed; once enabled, a small shield will be attached to each hand
 time attack mode can now be entered in starting room 
 added an exit option to time attack mode
 removed button reload
 removed mouse mode
 removed the ability to activate round shield

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Addressed a bug where  When you press the circle-pad in mid-transition to a diferent area, or back to the main room, the ammo magazine glitches and you can't reload
    Added a Time Attack Mode
    Added a new conditional section to Arcade Mode

notes.title: Update notes
notes.notes:
EDIT: Added the ability to reload by moving the gun close to the helmet
    Added a round shield - Press Trigger while equipping a shield to swap into the round shield
    Added illumination to make the magazine more visible 
    Added a mini-boss
    Added a checkpoint system with two possible checkpoints
    Fixed bugs in existing sections.

notes.title: 1/28/2017 update notes
notes.notes:
added a title screen
added option to toggle background music
added option to turn on mouse mode

details on mouse mode: 
left mouse click fires the weapon
right mouse click or keywoard key "R" reloads the weapon
note: mouse mode does not affect DLC weapon(s)

added iron sights to default weapon
made minor adjustments to existing sections
added 2 new sections
